name: Aeronaut
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Piloting Lore skill. You gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) skill feat with Piloting Lore.
